contact.basis: Adjacent ground on the Melbourne Street approach, apart from the elevated overpass and building.

verticalDatum: Source elevations in metres. Model heights are relative to the sampled Melbourne Street approach.
method: Original state elevation raster bilinearly sampled without flattening or clipping. The separately inspected global composite was discarded after reporting invalid hundreds-of-metres river depths.
limitations: Earth viewer terrain providers and vertical accuracy can differ. Local thresholds and discrete pedestrian levels are architectural estimates.
